# cycle_server (Data Source)

Looks up a Cycle server by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a server by ID.
data "cycle_server" "worker" {
  id = "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21"
}

output "worker_hostname" {
  value = data.cycle_server.worker.hostname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `cluster` (String) The identifier of the cluster the server is deployed into.
- `hostname` (String) The hostname assigned to the server.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this server belongs to.
- `integration_id` (String) The provider integration ID used to provision the server.
- `ips` (List of String) IP addresses assigned during provisioning (`provider.init_ips`).
- `location_id` (String) The provider location ID of the server.
- `model_id` (String) The provider server model ID.
- `nickname` (String) A custom display name for the server, if one has been set.
- `state` (String) The current state of the server.
